messages:
emily: Quick heads-up — I'm about to open a 10% promote for model v2-quant4-lite to prod tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Want to put a probationary quarantine that auto-escrows traffic for certain slices before full rollout. pinging for quick sign-off.
raj: Thumbs-up on probationary window. What slices are we quarantining?
emily: Longdocs (>2k tokens), system-instruction-heavy prompts, legal/finance intent slices. Also flagged user prompts that previously triggered hallucination regression in int8 tests.
mike: Can we get the A/B deltas from the last shadow run? I saw noise but need numbers.
emily: Shadow run summary: 50k samples. Delta MRR: -0.9% overall, but longdocs slice -2.4%. Hallucination rate +1.8% relative to baseline on finance slice. Latency p95 +12ms.
raj: Those longdoc and finance numbers are concerning. What's our auto-fallback criteria?
emily: Proposed auto-fallback rules: if any of these hit, instant fallback for affected slice -> baseline model: 1) delta_mrr <= -0.5% (stat sig) 2) halluc_delta >= +1.0% absolute 3) latency_p95 increase >= +20ms 4) error rate > 0.5%
mike: Suggest tweak: require sustained signal across two consecutive 15-min windows or >95% CI sample size, to avoid noisy single-bucket flips.
emily: Agreed — add hysteresis: need 2 consecutive windows OR cumulative sample N>500 for that slice. Also soft-penalty for small slices: only quarantine if slice traffic >0.2% of total.
olivia: Canary-bot, start a watchlist for v2-quant4-lite with these thresholds and post alerts to #incidents if triggered.
canary-bot: [automated] Watchlist created: model=v2-quant4-lite, rollout=10%, quarantined_slices=[longdoc, finance, system-prompt], thresholds={delta_mrr:-0.5,halluc:+1.0,latency_p95:+20ms,error_rate:0.5%}, hysteresis={windows:2,window_size:15m,min_samples:500}. Alert channel=#incidents.
raj: One more ask — set up a quiet-shadow where we route 2% traffic to v2 but do not affect user experience; that will give us earlier warmup signal for KV cache.
emily: Done. Add to rollout plan: 10% live with quarantine; 2% quiet-shadow baseline-only traffic for KV warmup.
mike: Runbook note: if fallback triggers, the rollout automation should 1) demote slice traffic immediately, 2) create a rollback incident with telemetry snapshot, 3) tag model as "quarantined" in model catalog and block further promotes until manual review.
emily: I'll add the runbook snippet into the release notes. Quick config excerpt (for ops):

```
rollout: 10%
quarantine_slices: [longdoc, finance, system_prompt]
auto_fallback: true
fallback_rules:
  - metric: delta_mrr
    threshold: -0.5
  - metric: halluc_delta
    threshold: 1.0
  - metric: latency_p95
    threshold_ms: 20
hysteresis: {windows:2,window_size:15m,min_samples:500}
```

raj: LGTM. When do we promote to 10%?
emily: Schedule: tomorrow 09:00 UTC, monitoring window 6 hours, primary oncall = mike, escalation = eng-sre.
mike: I'll be oncall and will monitor the dashboards. Can someone drop the shadow run raw CSV into the #eng-ml thread for quick triage?
emily: Uploading now: https://redwood-internal.s3/shadow-runs/v2q4-lite/summary.csv :paperclip: 
olivia: Added a short eval harness to automatically compute slice-level hallucination using the new classifier — will post results into #eng-ml and to the watchlist.
canary-bot: [automated] Scheduled promote job created for 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z, id=promote-1711409999. Auto-fallback enabled.
emily: Thanks everyone. If no objections, I'll proceed with the promote and follow the runbook. :thumbsup:
